messages:
Matt: quick follow-up from the dashboard perf sync — idea sketch: 'query-smoother' + authz warmup to cut panel tail latencies. problem: some panels wait on many per-row auth checks and we see 95p spikes when cache cold.

Elaine: can you sketch the user-visible behavior? worried about showing partial results.

Matt: yep. two UX modes: preview + final. preview returns a small set of rows ASAP with sensitive columns masked; final replaces preview when authz completes. callers can opt out by setting `preview=false`.

Sanjay: how do we avoid warming everything? prefetching naively will explode.

Matt: warm only high-traffic dashboards. heuristic: active_users_last_5m > 10 OR traffic_rank <= 200. also limit concurrent warms per-router. sample config: 

```yaml
panel:
  warmup_enabled: true
  warmup_window: 3m
  warmup_predicate: "active_users>10 or traffic_rank<=200"
  preview_columns_mask: ["email","api_key"]
  max_parallel_warms: 8
```

Rachel: implementation thought — instead of full row-by-row DB checks, compute a tenancy filter and a column-mask token at the edge router and attach it to the query. DB executes against filtered data and payload gets masked by router. keeps DB simpler.

Elaine: so router needs a small policy cache. suggested key: `tenant_id|policy_version|role_hash`. policy_version increments on role changes.

Sanjay: invalidation? we can rely on existing role-change webhook to bump policy_version, but we need TTL-based GC to avoid growth.

Matt: tradeoffs: + reduces DB work and 95p latency, + allows progressive results; - increases memory at router, - requires robust invalidation, - adds complexity to panel contract (preview vs final).

Rachel: rollout plan: feature flagged. start 5% canary on non-sensitive orgs. metrics to watch: panel_95p_latency, warmup_hit_ratio, authz_mismatch_rate, DB_cpu. if mismatch_rate > 0.1% rollback.

Matt: telemetry we should emit: `warmup_hit`, `preview_served`, `final_committed`, `mismatch_detected`. keep 1% sampled full-checks (bypass warmup) to validate correctness.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: canary job + perf harness + automated mismatch alerting. scheduled window: 2026-04-01T06:00Z for canary if CI green. :rocket:

Elaine: also suggest a short TTL for preview cache: `warmup_window + 30s` to avoid stale previews. and a tiny backoff if warmups repeatedly fail for a panel.

Sanjay: perf numbers from local sim: 500 concurrent panel views, 20% required per-row checks previously. with preview hits ~88% we saw DB CPU drop ~30% and 95p latency drop ~40% in the sim. need cluster-scale run tho.

Rachel: operational notes: add a 'debug' endpoint that returns whether a request was served preview vs final and the policy cache key used. helps triage mismatch incidents.

Matt: open action items: 
- Matt: draft RFC addendum describing the preview contract + API flag (this week)
- Elaine: prototype router policy cache + GC strategy (sprint)
- Sanjay: run cluster load tests with warmup enabled (next week)
- Rachel: write rollout playbook, feature flag config, and alert thresholds (this week)

Elaine: adding one more: include a per-panel opt-out tag so customers can opt out of preview for highly sensitive dashboards.

Matt: good call. adding to RFC. thanks all. :thumbsup:
